title: Gemini Robotics 2 Introduction
summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2 on July 30, 2026 as a vision-language-action model for intelligent whole-body robot control, alongside two additional models in the Gemini Robotics 2 family.
significance: A dated first-party AI-system release milestone in embodied AI and robotics, documenting a model family designed to connect multimodal reasoning with robot motor control.
